author: Sant Dnyaneshwar (Jnaneshwar Maharaj)
composedApprox: c. 1290 CE (Shaka 1212), in Marathi ovi meter
structureNote: Dnyaneshwari is a chapter-by-chapter Marathi commentary on the Bhagavad Gita, composed in the ovi verse form. It follows the Gita's traditional 18-chapter structure and chapter titles, and contains over 9,000 ovis in total.

chapterTitleSource.name: Traditional Bhagavad Gita chapter titles (followed by Dnyaneshwari as its source text's structure)
